claims.text:
13. ann-recall-speed

Target / packet: ai-ann-recall-speed · R3. Prerequisites: ai:retrieval-top-k.

Nearest / distinct payoff: retrieval-top-k → meaning-without-the-word. Exact top-k scans every candidate; this computes the actual recall and distance-check count of a bounded approximate inspection order.

Finite primary model: Points[0,2,3,9], query 2.6, exact nearest 3 distance.4. Approximate inspection order[0,9,2,3]. Budgets 2/3/4 return 0/2/3, recall@1=[0,0,1], distance checks=[2,3,4].

Countercase and mathematical boundary: Query .1 with budget 1 already returns exact 0. More budget can help this specific order but does not imply a universal speed/recall curve; no wall time or hardware claim.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict whether budget 3 retrieves exact nearest; recall when budget 1 suffices.

Required observable evidence: Show inspected candidates and current best distance; actual counted comparisons, not invented speed ups.

Source obligation: Declared local finite model. Exact results require independent arithmetic reproduction; this construction supports no real-model performance or universal improvement claim. Method-source obligations remain as listed in the acquisition record below.
